# Patch Board

Self-hosted, read-only dashboard answering "where do I need to patch things?"
across every GitHub repo its token can see: Dependabot alerts, update PRs with
CI verdicts, coverage gaps, scan freshness, risk scores — plus a prioritized,
machine-readable work queue for agents.

## Security model (read before acting)

- This service is a SENSOR and PLANNER only. It holds a read-only GitHub token
  and never writes to GitHub. There are no write endpoints.
- Actions in the queue carry literal `gh` CLI commands. YOU (the agent) execute
  them with YOUR OWN credentials, subject to your own operator's approval.
- Data comes from a background cache. Check the `stale` flag; when true, POST
  /api/gh/refresh first (it blocks until fresh), then re-read: refresh-then-read.
- CI verdicts are as of the last refresh. Re-verify with `gh pr checks` before
  merging anything.

## API (all JSON, no auth, LAN-only deployment)

- GET /api/gh/status — token state, last scan, rate limit, freshness. Always answers.
- GET /api/gh/actions — THE WORK QUEUE. One entry per executable step:
  {type, repo, pr?, verdict, why, command, preconditions?, policy, policyRule}.
  Types: merge_pr, close_superseded, enable_alerts, enable_security_updates,
  add_dependabot_config, flag_pr. Sorted executable-first, then by risk.
  policy is auto_ok or requires_human, decided by .patchboard-policy.yml
  (the operator's guardrails; policyRule names the rule). EXECUTE ONLY
  policy=auto_ok UNATTENDED — requires_human entries are for reporting.
  Policy is a brake, never an accelerator: it cannot promote past a verdict.
- GET /api/gh/merge-plan — conflict-aware merge ordering. Per-repo "trains"
  built from PR file overlap (lockfiles, usually): steps within a train are
  STRICTLY SEQUENTIAL and each carries its full command sequence including
  the rebase choreography; separate trains (and repos) run in parallel
  safely. Prefer this over draining merge_pr entries from /api/gh/actions
  by hand. Policy stamps apply here too.
- GET /api/gh/repos?filter=&search=&sort= — full per-repo posture: alerts by
  severity, Dependabot config state, PRs with CI rollups + verdict inputs,
  last-scan evidence, gaps, risk (0–100, weights documented in the README).
- GET /api/gh/prs?kind=dependabot|other|all — every open PR across repos.
- GET /api/gh/alerts?severity=&repo= — open vulnerability alerts.
- GET /api/gh/coverage — repos with scanning gaps and what to fix.
- POST /api/gh/refresh — force a rescan; responds when the cache is fresh.
- GET /api/digest.md — this data as a markdown morning briefing.
- GET /api/settings — token status (source + masked tail only). POST
  /api/settings/token sets the dashboard's own read-only GitHub token (the
  operator's settings page uses this; agents should not). Secrets are
  write-only: no endpoint ever returns a stored token.
- GET /api/openapi.json — machine-readable spec of everything above.
- GET /healthz — liveness. GET /health — health + version + integration state.
- /api/dates, /api/summary, /api/report/:date[/:agent[/md]], /api/findings,
  /api/diff/:d1/:d2?, /api/trends — nightly multi-agent audit reports
  (separate subsystem; empty unless audit data is mounted).

## MCP

mcp/server.js in the repo is a dependency-free stdio MCP server wrapping this
API (tools: get_status, refresh_and_wait, list_actions, get_merge_plan,
get_repo_posture, list_alerts, get_coverage_gaps). Point it here with
PATCHBOARD_URL. The repo's .mcp.json registers it for Claude Code.

## Verdicts

safe_to_merge = bot author + green CI + patch/minor bump. breaking_major =
major bump (never auto-merge). superseded = a sibling PR bumps the same
package to an equal-or-newer version (close, don't merge). needs_human =
human-authored, workflow-touching, or unparseable. red_ci / no_ci / ci_pending
/ draft = not actionable. Full logic: lib/verdicts.js.
